## Key Technical Concepts
- DSH is a Cordis-based plugin harness; UI extension via `ctx.slots.inject`/`register`; sidebar `sidebar.panellist` list slot + `main` keyed slot; root-scope children declared in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` and `-layout`.
- DSH runs from packed `app.asar` (not a directory) — must parse asar header manually to read shell source.
- Mirrors/registries: `registry = http://42.97.130.19:30006/repository/ccsc-cctds-npm-group`; pnpm hardlinks profile deps from `C:\Users\jjq21\AppData\Local\pnpm\store\v11`.
- Network: system proxy `127.0.0.1:7897` (Clash TUN) hijacks DNS to fake `198.18.0.x` → `web_fetch` unusable; all fetching done via Node `http.get({host:'127.0.0.1',port:7897,path:<fullURL>,headers:{Host:<realHost>}})`.
- GBK sites decoded with Node 22 built-in `new TextDecoder('gbk')` (iconv-lite NOT installed).
- Rate limits: Reddit RSS needs ≥100 s between requests (else 429); GitHub API 60 req/h unauthenticated (403 when exhausted); Zhihu 403 is a **risk-control/IP-layer block**, not a cookie problem.
- RSS/Atom is the reliable scraping surface where JSON APIs 403: Reddit `.rss`, `producthunt.com/feed`, `hnrss.org/show?points=100`, `v2ex.com/feed/sidehustle.json`.
- CDATA pitfall: hnrss `<title><![CDATA[...]]></title>` requires stripping `<![CDATA[` / `]]>` before matching.
- Vault conventions: `50-知识/` durable notes with YAML frontmatter (`date`,`time`,`tags`), `[[wikilinks]]`, `> AI 推测：` prefix for inference, `目录.md` must be synced, §0.3 commit+push every change with **Chinese commit message, no `feat:` prefixes**.

## Errors and Fixes
- `web_fetch` fails on every host: `URL hostname "X" resolves to a non-public IP address` → cause Clash TUN fake DNS; fixed by fetching through the proxy with Node `http.get`.
- `rg` on `D:\...\app.asar\dsh` → "系统找不到指定的路径" (asar is a file) → parsed the asar header with system Node, then extracted entries by offset.
- run_code sandbox `fs` is Electron's asar-patched fs → `ENOENT, not found in …app.asar` → used `& 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe' script.cjs`.
- TypeScript parser errors `Expected ',', got ':'` when embedding PowerShell/JS in template literals → fixed by building scripts as `string[]` + `.join("\n")` or JSON.stringify payloads; avoid `$var` and `${}` inside literals.
- `Node: Cannot find module 'iconv-lite'` → use `new TextDecoder('gbk')` instead.
- `setsetTimeout is not defined` typo → corrected.
- `SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression flags` — regex literal contained `/mo|/month` closing early → removed `/mo` alternatives.
- 52pojie/cnr.cn GBK garbage output → `TextDecoder('gbk')`.
- PowerShell `Format-Table` + `Out-String` param errors on one-liners → switched to script-file or Node execution.
- `git commit -m` broke on `$`/quotes ("pathspec … did not match any file(s) known to git") → wrote message to a temp file and used `git commit -F`.
- `Cannot set property env of #<Object>` when assigning `process.env` inside run_code → avoided env assignment, used `--data-dir` CLI args.
- `create_goal` rejected: goal `goal-aa4130f7…` already active → used `update_goal action=edit` instead.
- Stale job `pwsh-107` (agent-browser open) left running → killed via `job_kill`.
- **User correction**: "浏览器我在使用呢" — the user's browser was in use; agent-browser session closed immediately and never reopened.
- **User correction**: "搜索频率低一些 不要封了账号" — enforce 100 s spacing; cookies never printed; scripts self-deleted.
